usage: لو الناتج ناقص، الصق قيمة `send` للحالة المطابقة — لا تعيد البرومبت كلّه.

send.instruction: restrict #3030FF to the headline only; render all other text in #0E065A on white
scale the logo up 20% and keep clear space around it equal to its own height; never crop it
increase the softness of the shadow under the subject and feather the edge so it fades gradually into the background
render body text in solid #0E065A with no opacity; ensure contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1
increase white space by 30%, remove any glow or gloss, and reduce decorative elements to a single thin accent

fixes.problem: غيّر النصّ أو رتّب العناصر من نفسه

send.instruction: restore the exact original layout, wording, order and line breaks; change colour and treatment only
set the background to #F7F8FC with a very soft light-blue gradient in the top-right; no dark fills anywhere

fixes.problem: حطّ علامة صحّ بدل درع مدونتي

send.instruction: use the attached modonty-trust-shield.svg exactly as provided — a navy shield with cyan outline and the modonty m inside. Do not substitute a check mark, circle, ribbon or any other symbol.

fixes.problem: الدرع كبير أو بعيد عن الاسم

send.instruction: size the shield to about 1.2x the adjacent text line height and place it directly beside the name
increase headline size until it remains legible when the image is scaled to 250x250; reduce secondary text instead of shrinking the headline
keep every element at least 5% of the canvas away from all four edges
